import importlib.util,json,sys
from unittest.mock import patch
from pathlib import Path
from fpdf import FPDF
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('contract','/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python/tests/test_pdf_outline_contract.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
options=aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions()
options.outline_options.default_bookmarks_outline_level=10**9
options.outline_options.create_missing_outline_levels=True
calls=[]
original=FPDF.start_section
def guarded(self,name,*args,**kwargs):
 calls.append({'name':name,'level':kwargs.get('level')})
 if len(calls)>20:raise RuntimeError('controlled stop after 20 navigation allocations')
 return original(self,name,*args,**kwargs)
try:
 with patch.object(FPDF,'start_section',guarded):m.native_document().to_bytes(options)
 outcome='unexpected success'
except Exception as exc:outcome=type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc)
result={'package':aw.__file__,'requested_level':10**9,'allocated_navigation_calls':len(calls),'outcome':outcome}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result))

import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__,aw.__file__
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-current-performance');results={}
for case in ('small','hundred_pages','image_table','repeated_images','mixed_styles'):
 raw=aw.Document(root/(case+'.docx')).to_bytes(aw.saving.PdfSaveOptions())
 pages=[]
 with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
  for page in pdf:
   pages.append({key:hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for key,value in {'words':repr(page.get_text('words')).encode(),'pixels':page.get_pixmap().samples,'drawings':repr(page.get_drawings()).encode(),'images':repr(page.get_image_info()).encode()}.items()})
 results[case]={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':pages}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('five PDF corpora saved')
